title: Plane Floer homology and the odd Khovanov homology of 2-knots
summary: We prove a conjecture of Migdail and Wehrli regarding the odd Khovanov cobordism maps associated to knotted spheres. Our key tool is Daemi's plane Floer homology, which we use in place of a Lee deformation. Continuing the analogy with Lee homology, we see this work as a potential first step toward a genuinely functorial model for odd Khovanov homology.
